decisions.reason: As a close extension of the established range that still has its own product page after two years, it likely meets aspiration levels well enough for management to retain it.
This product fits the firm's core construction equipment capabilities and its continued full website presence suggests performance is acceptable relative to expectations and comparable offerings.

Because it is distant from the core offer and was downgraded from a full page to only a mention without positive performance evidence, management would likely see it as falling short of aspirations and reallocate resources.
The loader builds on existing competencies and its maintained standalone presentation indicates enough market acceptance for an innovative mid-sized firm with some slack to continue supporting it.
The reported popularity in rental and a current large order put results clearly above aspiration, so there is little reason to withdraw it.

Although more distant from the established portfolio, the strong early utilization evidence suggests promising performance, and with industry growth and internal R&D the firm is likely to keep developing it rather than exit quickly.
